en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3374 - In the narration of Al-Sakooni from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) from his forefathers from Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), who said that the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"There is no preemption (shufah) in a ship, nor in a river, nor in a road, nor in a mill, nor in a bathhouse."
